info.name: Wingz API — Assessment Test Suite
info.description:
Postman collection covering all spec requirements:
1. Authentication (admin role only)
2. Ride List API — pagination, filtering, sorting
3. todays_ride_events field (24h window)
4. Full CRUD for Rides and Users
5. Bonus SQL verification notes

Setup:
1. Import this file into Postman
2. Set the 'base_url' variable to http://127.0.0.1:8000
3. Run '0. Get Admin Token' first — token is saved automatically
4. All other requests use the saved token
